method: Independent full-source reading of the 12 assigned Darwin targets and 5 Henslow incoming sources from preserved HTML. Body prose, XML-linked identity/date constraints, exclusions, footnotes, scholarly material and bibliography were read; editorial summaries were kept separate. Matching used explicit dated acknowledgments, receipt, dispatch and distinctive answers, not order or topic overlap.
